assessment.nobel_worthiness: Structural empirical models of differentiated-product demand and competition have transformed industrial-organization analysis and applied policy evaluation.
assessment.attribution: Berry, Levinsohn, and Pakes provide the identifiable foundational core, though the broader listed research program has many major contributors.
assessment.maturity: The framework has been extensively developed, applied, and tested over decades.
uncertainties: The contribution is broad and cumulative, making a three-person attribution necessarily selective.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Firm heterogeneity and selection supplied a highly influential explanation of trade patterns, reallocation, and gains from trade.
assessment.attribution: Melitz is the clear central originator of the benchmark framework; Helpman and Redding made important related extensions.
assessment.maturity: The model has generated a large theoretical and empirical literature over more than two decades.
uncertainties: The empirical magnitude and welfare implications of trade-induced selection remain model- and setting-dependent.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The analysis of trade policy as an outcome of organized interests fundamentally reshaped political-economy accounts of protection.
assessment.attribution: Helpman and Grossman form a coherent and readily attributable partnership for the central theoretical contribution.
assessment.maturity: The work is long established and remains central to research on trade policy and lobbying.
uncertainties: Its policy predictions depend on stylized representations of political organization and institutions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Economic analysis of network effects, information technology, and digital-market competition has had enduring conceptual and policy importance.
assessment.attribution: Shapiro, Varian, and Farrell are central figures, but the listed contribution aggregates several overlapping literatures and participants.
assessment.maturity: The underlying ideas are mature and have become especially salient in modern competition policy.
uncertainties: The breadth of the package makes its precise prize-defining discovery less sharply bounded than some alternatives.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantitative Ricardian trade models made the gains from trade and counterfactual policy analysis more tractable and measurable.
assessment.attribution: Costinot, Kortum, and Rodriguez-Clare are plausible core contributors to the modern quantitative Ricardian program.
assessment.maturity: The approach has been widely adopted and applied to trade-policy questions.
uncertainties: Quantitative welfare conclusions rely on model structure, trade-cost measurement, and assumptions about adjustment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Research on task change and import competition substantially advanced understanding of technology, trade shocks, and labor-market inequality.
assessment.attribution: Autor, Dorn, and Hanson are strongly associated with the leading empirical evidence on these mechanisms.
assessment.maturity: The findings have prompted extensive follow-up research and materially affected public debate.
uncertainties: Estimated effects and their generality depend on exposure measures, time horizons, and local adjustment processes.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The measurement of resource misallocation gave growth accounting a powerful framework for studying cross-country productivity differences.
assessment.attribution: Hsieh and Klenow are the clear principal authors of the landmark empirical framework; related work by Restuccia is also important.
assessment.maturity: The approach is influential across development, trade, and industrial-organization research.
uncertainties: Residual-based measures of distortions can reflect measurement error and mechanisms other than policy misallocation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Their work connected exhaustible resources, natural capital, biodiversity, and long-run welfare in a consequential economic framework.
assessment.attribution: Dasgupta and Heal are closely associated with foundational work on natural resources and intertemporal sustainability.
assessment.maturity: The intellectual contribution is long standing and increasingly relevant to environmental accounting and policy.
uncertainties: The broad inclusive-wealth agenda combines foundational theory with normative and measurement choices.
